staticChecks.externalIntegrationReason: Requires changing existing enrolled local service; isolated component and process tests cover this stage.

failureHistory.result: Initial process failures retained: network fixture dropped every replacement response instead of one response; a short Context naturally expired before the explicit-close assertion. One-shot loss and ACTIVE-to-REVOKED preconditions corrected; 122 checks passed.
Final fresh scene: 286 full race tests, 130 adapter process checks, 102 RA09 and 375 prior protocol checks passed in sequence; worker cached-header renewal was additionally exercised.

verificationNotes: The helper headers command intentionally writes sensitive JSON to the native host private callback. That channel is never an MCP result or a public log; the test host consumes it in memory and records only safe header names and success checks.
Native HTTP host-hook and stdio are independently exercised with actual binaries and real gateway/PG services. A named coding product private-hook configuration and human UI acceptance remain RA18.
5 existing-service credential-renewal integration tests were not enabled because they mutate the existing enrolled service. Isolated lifecycle tests and 20 original script unit tests were run.
No runtime migrations or dependency versions changed. Original RA09 records and all previous stages remain preserved.
